newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egypt pound interbank overnight rates hold tight.
newsitem.headline: Egypt pound interbank overnight rates hold tight.

text.p: Overnight interbank rates on the Egyptian pound narrowed slightly on Wednesday to between 10 1/4 and 10 5/16 percent in a slightly tighter market from Tuesday's 10 1/4 to 10 3/8 percent, bankers said.
But one-week lending rates widened to 10 1/4 and 10 5/8 percent from 10 1/4 and 10 3/8 percent.
Many bankers said they were avoiding the Central Bank's 500 million pound repurchase offer because they were square. Others said the two-week period was too long.
"They should have done the repo early in the week when the market is normally short, and then borrowing for two weeks is a long time," a banker said.
Bankers added that cash-strapped public-sector banks were cashing in on the repo deal the most, and one was rumoured to have borrowed 300 million already.
The state-owned banks maintained their minimum overnight lending rate at 10 1/2 percent.
